Private Sub Form_BeforeUpdate(Cancel As Integer)
If IsNull(Me.txtProductName) Or Me.txtProductName = "" Then
 MsgBox "Tên sản phẩm không được để trống!", vbCritical
 Cancel = True
 End If
End Sub

2.2. If the product name is empty or null, display a critical message to the user stating that the product name cannot be left blank
2.3. Prevent the form from being updated and cancel the current operation

Private Sub btnDelete_Click()
If MsgBox("Bạn có chắc chắn muốn xóa sản phẩm này?", vbYesNo + vbQuestion) = vbYes Then
 DoCmd.RunSQL "DELETE FROM TBL_Products WHERE ProductID = " & Me.txtProductID
 DoCmd.Close acForm, "F_ProductDetail"
 End If
End Sub

step_2.detail:
2.1. ユーザーに確認メッセージを表示する
2.2. ユーザーが確認メッセージで「はい」を選択した場合、以下の処理を行う
2.2.1. TBL_ProductsテーブルからtxtProductIDの値に基づいて該当するレコードを削除する
2.2.2. F_ProductDetailフォームを閉じる [refer: F_ProductDetail]
